title: The Dark Origins of Fairy Tales

cues.text: An evil stepmother demands a beautiful maiden’s lungs and liver;
cues.en: An evil stepmother demands a beautiful maiden’s lungs and liver;
cues.zh: 邪惡繼母想要得到 美麗少女的肺和肝；

cues.text: a girl is ripped from a wolf’s stomach;
cues.en: a girl is ripped from a wolf’s stomach;
cues.zh: 一個女孩從狼剖開的肚子裡 被救了出來；

cues.text: and sisters mutilate their feet to squeeze into a solid gold slipper.
cues.en: and sisters mutilate their feet to squeeze into a solid gold slipper.
cues.zh: 姐姐們割傷自己的腳，只為了 把腳塞進一隻純金的鞋子裡。

cues.text: During the early 1800s,
cues.en: During the early 1800s,
cues.zh: 在 1800 年代初期，

cues.text: brothers Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm gathered these unflinchingly gory details
cues.en: brothers Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm gathered these unflinchingly gory details
cues.zh: 雅各和威廉‧格林兄弟

cues.text: from stories circulating around what’s now Germany.
cues.en: from stories circulating around what’s now Germany.
cues.zh: 從如今的德國各地所流傳的民間故事， 蒐集了這些露骨的血腥細節。

cues.text: But as the tales amassed widespread fame, they morphed dramatically.
cues.en: But as the tales amassed widespread fame, they morphed dramatically.
cues.zh: 但隨著這些故事聲名大噪，

cues.text: The Brothers Grimm were born in Hanau in the 1780s.
cues.en: The Brothers Grimm were born in Hanau in the 1780s.
cues.zh: 格林兄弟於 1780 年代出生於哈瑙。

cues.text: At the time, Germanic lands didn’t yet exist
cues.en: At the time, Germanic lands didn’t yet exist
cues.zh: 當時，日耳曼地區尚未形成 一個統一的德國民族國家，

cues.text: as the unified nation-state of Germany,
cues.en: as the unified nation-state of Germany,
cues.zh: 當時，日耳曼地區尚未形成 一個統一的德國民族國家，

cues.text: but were instead divided into small, independent princedoms.
cues.en: but were instead divided into small, independent princedoms.
cues.zh: 而是分裂成小型的獨立公國。

cues.text: And French forces exerted significant control over the region
cues.en: And French forces exerted significant control over the region
cues.zh: 法國軍隊對該地有很大的掌控權，

cues.text: as a result of Napoleon's expansionist aims.
cues.en: as a result of Napoleon's expansionist aims.
cues.zh: 這是拿破崙的擴張主義目標 所導致的結果。

cues.text: Meanwhile, European Romanticism was beginning to flourish,
cues.en: Meanwhile, European Romanticism was beginning to flourish,
cues.zh: 與此同時，歐洲浪漫主義 正開始蓬勃發展，

cues.text: accompanied by movements to preserve national languages and traditions.
cues.en: accompanied by movements to preserve national languages and traditions.
cues.zh: 隨之而來的是儲存 母語和傳統的運動。

cues.text: In their teens, the Brothers Grimm enrolled to study law at university,
cues.en: In their teens, the Brothers Grimm enrolled to study law at university,
cues.zh: 格林兄弟在青少年時期 就進入大學攻讀法律，

cues.text: and soon became interested in how local rules and customs
cues.en: and soon became interested in how local rules and customs
cues.zh: 很快地，他們就對於 當地的規則和習俗

cues.text: were embedded in folk stories.
cues.en: were embedded in folk stories.
cues.zh: 如何融入民間故事中倍感興趣。

cues.text: It wasn’t long before they began undertaking their own
cues.en: It wasn’t long before they began undertaking their own
cues.zh: 不久後，他們開始投入他們 自己的浪漫民族主義計畫，

cues.text: Romantic-nationalist project,
cues.en: Romantic-nationalist project,
cues.zh: 四處搜羅各種德意志民間傳說，

cues.text: soliciting all manner of German folklore,
cues.en: soliciting all manner of German folklore,
cues.zh: 四處搜羅各種德意志民間傳說，

cues.text: striving, they said, “to penetrate into the wild forests of  ancestors.”
cues.en: striving, they said, “to penetrate into the wild forests of  ancestors.”
cues.zh: 引用他們的話，他們在努力「深入 探索他們祖先的那片原始森林」。

cues.text: Their aim was to foster a unifying sense of German cultural identity.
cues.en: Their aim was to foster a unifying sense of German cultural identity.
cues.zh: 他們的目標是培養 對德國文化認同的凝聚力。

cues.text: They idolized the idea of stories from the so-called “common man,”
cues.en: They idolized the idea of stories from the so-called “common man,”
cues.zh: 他們崇尚的概念， 是故事要來自「一般百姓」，

cues.text: which they viewed as evidence of a national “unspoiled imagination”
cues.en: which they viewed as evidence of a national “unspoiled imagination”
cues.zh: 他們認為這是一個國家「想像力 未受汙染」且「內在純潔」的證據。

cues.text: and “inner purity.”
cues.en: and “inner purity.”
cues.zh: 實際上，他們收集到的故事 多半來自中高階級的管道，

cues.text: In practice, much of what they collected came from middle and upper class sources,
cues.en: In practice, much of what they collected came from middle and upper class sources,
cues.zh: 實際上，他們收集到的故事 多半來自中高階級的管道，

cues.text: and some stories had traceably transnational origins.
cues.en: and some stories had traceably transnational origins.
cues.zh: 有些故事的起源甚至 可追溯到其他國家。

cues.text: But the Grimms received material spanning songs, jokes, fables,
cues.en: But the Grimms received material spanning songs, jokes, fables,
cues.zh: 但格林兄弟收到的素材 包羅永珍，包括民謠、

cues.text: and magic fairy tales,
cues.en: and magic fairy tales,
cues.zh: 笑話、寓言及充滿 魔幻色彩的童話，

cues.text: from books and educated young women, as well as a painter and a former soldier,
cues.en: from books and educated young women, as well as a painter and a former soldier,
cues.zh: 來自書籍、受過教育的年輕女性，

cues.text: though they probably collected the most from the wife of a tailor.
cues.en: though they probably collected the most from the wife of a tailor.
cues.zh: 不過，提供他們最多素材的 可能是一名裁縫的妻子。

cues.text: They published their first volume, “Children’s and Household Tales,” in 1812.
cues.en: They published their first volume, “Children’s and Household Tales,” in 1812.
cues.zh: 1812 年，他們出版了 《兒童與家庭童話集》第一冊。

cues.text: But from the stepmother who serves her husband his own son for dinner,
cues.en: But from the stepmother who serves her husband his own son for dinner,
cues.zh: 但，從繼母把丈夫的親生兒子 做成晚餐給他吃，

cues.text: to the man who murders his brother in order to marry a princess
cues.en: to the man who murders his brother in order to marry a princess
cues.zh: 到男子為了和公主結婚 而殺害親兄弟，

cues.text: and then gets drowned in a sack,
cues.en: and then gets drowned in a sack,
cues.zh: 後來被裝進布袋裡淹死，

cues.text: these stories were far from cozy.
cues.en: these stories were far from cozy.
cues.zh: 這些故事都讓人蠻不舒服的。

cues.text: In fact, originally, the stories were for adults,
cues.en: In fact, originally, the stories were for adults,
cues.zh: 事實上，這些故事 最初的物件是成人，

cues.text: and often dealt with difficult realities,
cues.en: and often dealt with difficult realities,
cues.zh: 且通常會涉及困難的現實，

cues.text: like parents abandoning their children in the woods due to poverty
cues.en: like parents abandoning their children in the woods due to poverty
cues.zh: 比如父母因為貧窮 而把孩子丟棄在森林中，

cues.text: and weary soldiers deserting the army.
cues.en: and weary soldiers deserting the army.
cues.zh: 以及疲憊計程車兵逃離軍隊。

cues.text: The happier turns were often escapist fantasies from harsh circumstances,
cues.en: The happier turns were often escapist fantasies from harsh circumstances,
cues.zh: 故事中較美好的轉折通常都是 脫離艱苦境況的逃避現實式幻想，

cues.text: like a princess who throws a frog she's forced to marry against a wall,
cues.en: like a princess who throws a frog she's forced to marry against a wall,
cues.zh: 比如被迫嫁給青蛙的公主 將那隻青蛙往牆上一扔，

cues.text: only to reveal a dashing prince.
cues.en: only to reveal a dashing prince.
cues.zh: 青蛙卻變成瀟灑的王子。

cues.text: The first two volumes the Brothers Grimm published
cues.en: The first two volumes the Brothers Grimm published
cues.zh: 格林兄弟出版的前兩冊童話集

cues.text: tended to reflect the horror and strangeness of the tales
cues.en: tended to reflect the horror and strangeness of the tales
cues.zh: 多半反映出他們最初收集到的 故事中的恐怖怪誕色彩。

cues.text: they originally collected.
cues.en: they originally collected.
cues.zh: 但是許多讀者覺得 這些內容讓人不安，

cues.text: But many readers found their content disturbing, and they didn’t sell well.
cues.en: But many readers found their content disturbing, and they didn’t sell well.
cues.zh: 但是許多讀者覺得 這些內容讓人不安，

cues.text: However, an English version that was shorter, heavily illustrated,
cues.en: However, an English version that was shorter, heavily illustrated,
cues.zh: 然而，

cues.text: and geared towards children, did.
cues.en: and geared towards children, did.
cues.zh: 竟賣得很好。

cues.text: And as their financial and family obligations grew,
cues.en: And as their financial and family obligations grew,
cues.zh: 隨著他們的經濟壓力 和家庭責任與日俱增，

cues.text: the brothers began to edit more actively.
cues.en: the brothers began to edit more actively.
cues.zh: 兩兄弟開始更積極進行修改。

cues.text: In 1825, the Brothers Grimm published a “Small Edition”
cues.en: In 1825, the Brothers Grimm published a “Small Edition”
cues.zh: 1825 年，格林兄弟 出版了「精選版」，

cues.text: that incorporated illustrations
cues.en: that incorporated illustrations
cues.zh: 書中納入插圖，希望能迎合新興、

cues.text: and was intended to appeal to newer, Romantic ideals of childhood
cues.en: and was intended to appeal to newer, Romantic ideals of childhood
cues.zh: 書中納入插圖，希望能迎合新興、

cues.text: and more conservative, middle and upper class Christian sensibilities.
cues.en: and more conservative, middle and upper class Christian sensibilities.
cues.zh: 以及較保守的中上階級 基督徒的價值觀。

cues.text: A gory tale of kids “playing” pig and butcher, for example,
cues.en: A gory tale of kids “playing” pig and butcher, for example,
cues.zh: 比如，有個關於小孩們 「扮演」屠夫殺豬的血腥故事

cues.text: didn’t make the cut.
cues.en: didn’t make the cut.
cues.zh: 就沒有被選入。

cues.text: Meanwhile, the original negligent biological mothers
cues.en: Meanwhile, the original negligent biological mothers
cues.zh: 而《白雪公主》和《糖果屋》中 原本無情的親生母親角色

cues.text: of “Snow White” and “Hansel and Gretel”
cues.en: of “Snow White” and “Hansel and Gretel”
cues.zh: 在後續的版本中 都被改寫為邪惡的繼母，

cues.text: transformed into wicked stepmothers in later editions,
cues.en: transformed into wicked stepmothers in later editions,
cues.zh: 在後續的版本中 都被改寫為邪惡的繼母，

cues.text: helping reinforce traditional gender roles
cues.en: helping reinforce traditional gender roles
cues.zh: 有助於鞏固傳統性別角色，

cues.text: framing biological mothers as virtuous, feminine, and nurturing.
cues.en: framing biological mothers as virtuous, feminine, and nurturing.
cues.zh: 把親生母親形塑為賢良、 女性化且充滿母愛的樣貌。

cues.text: And while at first Rapunzel was revealed to have been entertaining
cues.en: And while at first Rapunzel was revealed to have been entertaining
cues.zh: 雖然一開始，長髮公主 一直在款待王子這位訪客的事，

cues.text: her princely visitor when she becomes pregnant;
cues.en: her princely visitor when she becomes pregnant;
cues.zh: 是因為她懷了孕才曝光的，

cues.text: with revision, she simply let slip about him—
cues.en: with revision, she simply let slip about him—
cues.zh: 但後來被修改成她只是 說溜嘴提到他而已——

cues.text: no out-of-wedlock sex implied.
cues.en: no out-of-wedlock sex implied.
cues.zh: 沒有暗示任何未婚性行為。

cues.text: The brothers also accentuated some retributive violence,
cues.en: The brothers also accentuated some retributive violence,
cues.zh: 格林兄弟還強調了 一些報應性質的暴力，

cues.text: making for more cautionary tales.
cues.en: making for more cautionary tales.
cues.zh: 為故事增添警世意味。

cues.text: For example, the Grimms’ earliest version of Cinderella
cues.en: For example, the Grimms’ earliest version of Cinderella
cues.zh: 比如，格林兄弟最初版的《灰姑娘》

cues.text: ends after she is whisked away in her prince’s carriage,
cues.en: ends after she is whisked away in her prince’s carriage,
cues.zh: 在灰始娘被王子的馬車 接走後就結束了，

cues.text: while their last version concludes with birds pecking out her stepsisters’ eyes.
cues.en: while their last version concludes with birds pecking out her stepsisters’ eyes.
cues.zh: 但他們最後一版的結局 卻是鳥兒啄出繼姐的雙眼。

cues.text: Over their lifetimes, the brothers published seven editions of the tales,
cues.en: Over their lifetimes, the brothers published seven editions of the tales,
cues.zh: 格林兄弟一生總共出版了 七個版本的故事集，

cues.text: which became increasingly popular as they deleted and added stories
cues.en: which became increasingly popular as they deleted and added stories
cues.zh: 一版比一版更受歡迎，

cues.text: while intensively editing them to fit more puritanical tastes
cues.en: while intensively editing them to fit more puritanical tastes
cues.zh: 同時大刀闊斧做編修， 以符合更保守的清教徒口味，

cues.text: and amplifying narrative and descriptive details.
cues.en: and amplifying narrative and descriptive details.
cues.zh: 還強化敘事和細節描寫。

cues.text: Additional adaptations by others saw the stories evolve further.
cues.en: Additional adaptations by others saw the stories evolve further.
cues.zh: 其他人的改編版本 又讓這些故事有更多演變。

cues.text: No longer would Snow White be revived by a stumbling pallbearer,
cues.en: No longer would Snow White be revived by a stumbling pallbearer,
cues.zh: 白雪公主不再是因為 抬棺的侍從絆倒而甦醒，

cues.text: but a prince’s kiss,
cues.en: but a prince’s kiss,
cues.zh: 而是因為王子的吻，

cues.text: and henceforth her witchy stepmother wouldn’t dance herself to death
cues.en: and henceforth her witchy stepmother wouldn’t dance herself to death
cues.zh: 也因此之後她那女巫般的繼母也不會

cues.text: in iron shoes on a scorching bed of coals.
cues.en: in iron shoes on a scorching bed of coals.
cues.zh: 在炙燒的煤炭上穿著鐵鞋跳舞至死。

cues.text: In other words, they'd grow to be not quite so unconventional
cues.en: In other words, they'd grow to be not quite so unconventional
cues.zh: 換言之，

cues.text: or grim as their origins.
cues.en: or grim as their origins.
cues.zh: 這些故事漸漸變得不再 像原版那樣反傳統或殘酷恐怖。
